tiktok.author: amzzzzz9v2
tiktok.body:
I’m sick of it 😭😭😭😭😭 #uk #dola #subscriptions #relatable #funny
Why does everything need a subscription for my brother? I bought the thing, why am I still paying for it? You buy a doorbell 4 99 a month. You buy a camera 7 99 a month. You buy an app to help you save money 9 99 a month. Bro, you're the problem. And the worst thing is forget what you even subscribe to in the first place. I checked my bank the other day. Deduction of 6 99. What on earth is that for? And another 1299. What? Apparently I've been paying for something since February if you ask me. I don't even remember February. At this point I'm scared to even check my bank statement because I know there's a free trial from 2024. Fighting for his life somewhere. So I actually want to know why do companies love subscription so much? So let me ask Dola, why are so many companies switching to subscription models instead of one time payments? Great question. The shift from one time payments to subscriptions is and to be honest, it actually makes sense. Recurring revenue, more predictable income, keeping customers for longer. I'll be honest, I'm still not happy about it cause now I've realized probably need to check what I'm actually paying for. But why don't I know all my monthly expenses? So let me get everything together. Subscriptions, my phone Bill, my cloud storage, everything. Let me switch to pro mode. And in pro mode Dola has Various formats you can specify to it to help you. So for me, I want to generate a website. So I've asked Dola to organise my monthly expenses into a visual workflow. Separate essential bills, useful subscriptions and things I should review or cancel. Show me what I should check first. And it does exactly that. Look at this. Created a whole website. Now I've actually got it laid out, you know, the stuff I need and the stuff I use and the subscriptions that have basically been taking my money in silence. Lovely. Pro mode works on your phone as well as your computer. Dola is completely free with no ads and no limits. Go ahead and download it now.

tiktok.author: dudeinthedurag
tiktok.body: When did “free app” stop meaning FREE? 😭 You can download an app for free, but the second you want the features that actually made you download it, suddenly it’s $4.99/month, $29.99/year, or a 7-day free trial you’ll probably forget to cancel. 💀 I understand why subscriptions exist. Developers have employees, servers, updates, customer support, and other costs. Some subscriptions genuinely make sense. But subscriptions have become SO normalized that everything wants recurring payments now photo editors, fitness apps, productivity tools, cloud storage, AI apps, streaming services, even basic utilities. Apple didn’t invent subscriptions, but I think the App Store played a major role in making this model feel normal. Instead of paying $5 once, companies can potentially turn that into a recurring monthly payment. And that’s where I have an issue. If an app is advertised as “FREE,” but most of the useful features are locked behind a subscription, is it really free? At this point, I don’t need another app. I need an app to keep track of all the subscriptions I’m already paying for. 😭😂 Have subscriptions gotten out of control, or is this just the natural evolution of software? #Apple #Samsung #iPhoneDuo #Netflix #Spotify
